name: web-terminal
tagline: Self-hosted mobile-first web terminal via Ghostty WASM
description: web-terminal is a self-hosted, mobile-first web terminal built on Ghostty compiled to WebAssembly. It brings a real terminal into the browser so you can reach your machine from a phone or any browser without a native app. The mobile-first design tackles the hard problem of making a terminal usable on small screens. It is an early experiment in running a full emulator in the browser for ubiquitous, on-the-go terminal access.
highlights: Real terminal in the browser via Ghostty compiled to WASM
Self-hosted, so you control who reaches your machine
Mobile-first design for terminal access on a phone
Runs a full emulator in the browser for ubiquitous access
curatorNote: Running Ghostty through WASM to get a real, mobile-usable terminal in the browser is ambitious and clever. An early but promising take on ubiquitous terminal access.
